mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(PAY_SEQ) AS totalCount, COALESCE(SUM(PAY_AMT), 0) AS totalAmt FROM TB_DONATION_PAYMENT WHERE MBR_SEQ = #{mbrSeq} AND PAY_STATUS = 'DONE'

SELECT * FROM TB_DONATION_PAYMENT WHERE MBR_SEQ = #{mbrSeq} AND PAY_STATUS IN ('DONE', 'CANCEL', 'REFUND')
AND PAY_TYPE = #{payType}
ORDER BY PAY_DT ASC
ORDER BY PAY_DT DESC
SELECT IFNULL(MAX(REGULAR_ROUND), 0) FROM TB_DONATION_PAYMENT WHERE MBR_SEQ = #{mbrSeq} AND PAY_TYPE = 'REGULAR' AND PAY_STATUS IN ('DONE', 'WAIT')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_DONATION_PAYMENT (ORDER_ID, MBR_SEQ, CAMP_SEQ, PAY_TYPE, PAY_AMT, PAY_STATUS, CHEER_MSG, REG_DT, REGULAR_ROUND) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{mbrSeq}, #{campSeq}, #{payType}, #{payAmt}, 'WAIT', #{cheerMsg}, NOW(), #{regularRound})
mapper.update:

PAY_STATUS = #{payStatus}, PAY_DT = NOW(), PAY_METHOD = #{payMethod}, PAYMENT_KEY = #{paymentKey}, BILLING_KEY = #{billingKey},
CANCEL_DT = NOW(), CANCEL_RSN = #{cancelRsn},
REFUND_DT = NOW(), REFUND_RSN = #{refundRsn},
